svg.aria-label: wireframe schematic — the app’s own layout, drawn frame by frame: the given, then each beat. given the guide at #howitworks; beat 1: you open it → two acts tell the same three moments — assigning work, reviewing it, two weeks later — first without the tool ("Done, boss!", a wall of code, the same bug back) then with it, every step a drawn scene; beat 2: you click → the walkthrough steps forward one scene and holds — it never advances on its own
